import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
df.columns = ['category', 'item', 'amount']
# expense lines: rows 10-21 (0-indexed) => category in col A, amount in col C
exp = df.loc[10:21, ['category','amount']].dropna(subset=['amount'])
exp['amount'] = exp['amount'].astype(float)
by_cat = exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum()
print('Per-category totals:')
print(by_cat.to_string())
print()
print('Grand total expenses:', by_cat.sum())
print('Number of expense line items:', len(exp))
"
